cand.title: AIC announcement gives dates, Punta Cana location and continental professional participation.
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence and destination fit; accessibility is reduced where venue is committed or sourcing is unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Bacilio Sánchez is ICPARD national president and president of the CIC 2027 organizing committee: the strongest local commercial-routing contact because the committee is actively addressing accommodation and logistics. Nelson Hahn Jacobo is AIC president for 2025–2027 and participates directly in CIC planning: an executive sponsor and escalation route. Neither source establishes personal hotel-contract signature authority; neither is represented here as a confirmed procurement buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming XXXVII CIC: 14–16 October 2027, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. These are activity dates stated in AIC’s 7 November 2026 announcement, not its publication date. The edition falls within the requested horizon. An October 2024 Puerto Rico Colegio message described a Puerto Rico 2027 plan; the newer AIC announcement explicitly places this edition in Punta Cana. The reason for the change is not established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana is more credible for a bounded national delegation, accompanying-person stay, pre/post extension or small satellite meeting than for the entire continental congress. Its official meeting page states 620 guestrooms, three event rooms, 380 m², 300 conference guests and 200 banquet guests on Uvero Alto Beach. The 2015 CIC forecast exceeded 2,500 colleagues, a historical forecast only—not 2027 attendance. A full-congress proposal should therefore wait for the 2027 plenary/breakout brief. Guestroom-led all-inclusive resort use is plausible; transfers, meal-plan economics and the eventual venue location must be tested.
findings.venueCommitments: No named 2027 event venue or host hotel was identified in the reviewed AIC announcement, technical invitation or organizing-committee report. Punta Cana is a destination commitment, not a property commitment. Hard Rock is evidenced for the 2015 CIC only and must not be carried forward to 2027. No evidence establishes that 2027 demand is already committed to a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Selected recent timeline: 2015 Punta Cana, 2017 Lima, 2019 Cartagena, 2021 Porto Alegre, 2023 Antigua Guatemala, 2025 Asunción; 2027 Punta Cana announced. The 2015 venue was Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Punta Cana–Bávaro; 2023 Hotel Museo Spa Casa Santo Domingo; 2025 Sheraton Asunción Hotel and Centro de Convenciones Paseo La Galería. AIC labels the series “bianual”; the edition-year sequence supports an every-two-years series, not an annual Punta Cana event or a fixed-hotel renewal.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing is unconfirmed, not proven open or closed. The 6 November 2026 committee report explicitly includes alojamiento, logistics, finance and registrations among planning workstreams, but identifies no accommodation buyer, appointed agency, hotel block, rates or reservation channel. Historically, the 2025 organizer offered three tourist operators for accommodation, transfers and packages alongside a reference hotel list; that is a historical distribution model, not a 2027 appointment or proof of contracted room inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: This is an association-led professional conference, not a corporate incentive or a travel agency-owned programme. AIC is the stated organizer; ICPARD is the stated sponsoring national professional body, with its president chairing the local organizing committee. No 2027 PCO or DMC appointment was identified in the reviewed materials. Venue ownership and hotel procurement authority remain separate and unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The hotel’s 300-person conference capacity limits whole-congress suitability if 2027 scale resembles the much larger historical 2015 forecast; this is a conditional inference, not a 2027 capacity finding. No sold-out incumbent, overflow requirement, displacement, contracted competitor block or unmet room demand was found. Historical Hard Rock use does not establish current incumbent status. No Cap Cana, La Romana or Bayahibe venue was verified, and those competitive destinations are not counted as hotel demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact ICPARD at its published main-office number (809) 688-7080 and request Bacilio Sánchez’s organizing-committee accommodation/logistics lead. In parallel, use administracion@contadores-aic.org or asistenteadmon@contadores-aic.org to request routing through Nelson Hahn’s team. Ask for the 2027 venue decision, contracted versus unallocated accommodation, procurement authority/agency, selection timetable, delegate room budget and nightly pattern, and permission to quote a separable delegation block. Present the resort’s 620 guestrooms and 300-person meeting limit transparently. Do not issue an assumed congress buyout or label overflow until the committee supplies evidence.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the target 2027 edition, relationship access is evidenced by named active leaders and public institutional channels. Commercial inventory access is unknown: no public hotel RFP, sourcing window, booking portal or room block was identified. Approach as an accommodation-status qualification lead, not an accessible confirmed room-night opportunity. The 2025 edition is historical and is not a current sales opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: seek consideration for a 2027 delegation block or ancillary stay only after the committee confirms separable accommodation demand and transport practicality. If the principal venue/lodging is already contracted, pursue future sourcing relationships rather than claiming the incumbent can be displaced. The rotating every-two-years series supports relationship development, not an assumed 2028 Punta Cana edition or a confirmed next local cycle.
